name: Neumann images and plate relations
description: The shared archetypal whole in sequence: the round, its metabolism, the world-parent separation with the paśu correction, the twins' signed alternative, the hero's two emancipations and Osiris transformation, centroversion, the performable paper scene, the self-rolling wheel, and the return bond.

text.kicker: #0 · Neumann's creation sequence; the essay's structural priority of relation
text.title: The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them
text.italic: The whole carries shared archetypal structuration — genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay — through which situated tellings become comparable.

text.body: Heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann; shared structuration is what makes situated tellings comparable.
Occurrences: the round's outline and contents (#0); the parental unity before opposition (#0, differentiated at #2); the dependent ego (#0, becoming centre at #3).

text.kicker: #1 · the digestive leads pp.27–33; samāveśa (human-amplified: yes); C26 monoisation
text.title: The round lives by taking into itself
text.italic: The image demonstrates receiving as an operation: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity — incorporation becomes counter-generation when the centre monopolises renewal.

text.body: Mouth meets tail; hunger prevents an inert totality. The digestive leads at pp.27–33 give the round interior movement: intake and expenditure, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. What gives birth also has power to take back — the Mother's two faces. Prajāpati's self-offering gives the pressure a named form; at p.27 Mono–Śiva receives Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa (human-amplified: yes). Saturnine intake permits no new birth.

Occurrences: mouth/tail and hunger (#0–#1); the Mother's two faces (#1); Prajāpati and the horse/universe (#1, nested encounter); the Śaiva assimilation relation (#1); Saturnine counter-generation (#1, developed in the uroboros whole).

text.title: Separation of the World Parents — and the paśu correction
text.italic: The correction qualifies the return: the acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation that cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears.

text.body: Separation opens the interval in which a world can appear: heaven distinguishable from earth, light entering between. At the p.105 lead the primordial person recognises itself, then divides — self-recognition precedes sexual separation; the androgyne performs a relational office. Taylor's correction: prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession (human-amplified: yes). A measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it (Māyā, C14).
Occurrences: the parental separation (#0, #2); the embrace, division and changed relation (#2); the oriented world's boundaries (#2); the day/night/four-directions 4+2 (#2).

text.kicker: #2 · core theorem IV; Q27 energetics and Neumann return; A13/A18 (human-amplified: yes)
text.title: The twins — and the signed alternative
text.italic: The image demonstrates the changed operator: through the slash their different valences keep one ground; addition cancels them; subtraction lets one side take the span as its own.

text.body: The broken halves of a prior 0 become enemies when division denies their belonging. Their opposition has real force; the relation's holding is what changes. Through the slash their valences keep one ground; addition cancels; subtraction lets one side take the span as its own. The return preserves the two who can recognise their shared genesis: the prior 0 comes back as condition, not null of collision.
Occurrences: the prior 0 and its broken halves (#2); the three arithmetic results (#2, shared with the Māyā and uroboros wholes); the recognition question (#2, returning at #5→0).

scenes.name: The hero's two emancipations; the captive and treasure; Osiris
scenes.character: Slaying of the mother, then of the father — keeping both in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, not the replacement of one captor by another.

entities.name: the hero born within the opened world
the maternal struggle — the engulfing origin

the captive, the treasure, liberation — tested by what release makes possible
the Osiris transformation — death preventing closure as victorious identity

text.kicker: #3 · Neumann's sequence; the essay's authored pressure on liberation; C21/A20
text.title: The hero's two emancipations; the captive and treasure; Osiris
text.italic: Heroic efficacy is judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters — a captive liberated into another possession would leave the deeper problem intact.

text.body: Born within the opened world, the hero carries two emancipations: slaying of the mother, then the father. Stopping after the first would let the father's law inherit enclosure; keeping both answers emancipation to the formation of a centre. The captive and treasure: efficacy is judged by the relation release makes possible — the essay's authored pressure. Osiris: death prevents closure as victorious identity. The hero/avatar question stays open (human-amplified: no).
Occurrences: the two emancipations in sequence (#3); the captive and treasure (#3); the Osiris transformation office (#3); the open hero/avatar question (#3).

scenes.name: The paper scene — the return made performable
scenes.character: Write 1. Attend to the paper and write 0. Inscribe the slash. The written 0/1 is itself a figure; erase it — the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing is not cancelled.

entities.name: the blank sheet

text.kicker: #4 · Taylor's paper/mark/slash/erasure operation (human-amplified: yes); A11/C49; A12
text.title: The paper scene — the return made performable
text.italic: Erasure changes what dissolution can accomplish: uroboric reabsorption surrenders the differentiated position; the enacted erasure leaves a reader able to begin again with knowledge of the inscription's dependence.

text.body: Begin with a blank sheet. Write 1; write 0; inscribe the slash. The written 0/1 is itself a determinate figure that can be erased: what disappears is the inscription, not the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing. At p.17 the 1 slipping back into 0 becomes performable on the page (human-amplified: yes) — enacted erasure leaves a reader able to begin again, where uroboric reabsorption surrenders the differentiated position.
Occurrences: the written 1, 0 and slash (#4); the erased figure and remaining capacity (#4); the incest/erasure connection at p.17 (#4); the wheel's continuing composition (next).

text.title: The self-rolling wheel — continuing self-composition
text.italic: The wheel extends continuing formation from its exact p.18 office: a locally completed round retaining the passage through which it was made — the opening constitutive without becoming surface.

text.body: En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness stand beside the wheel: its rolling is continuing self-composition about the unobjectified opening — the winding of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once. The paper's capacity for another inscription and the wheel's composition meet here: each achieved figure belongs to the field through which another can appear. The wheel returns-to the uroboros's interposition; neither perpetual motion nor a topology theorem is established.
Occurrences: En-Soph at the −/− office of the ratified recapitulation (#4b, with tohubohu at p.106); the rolling composition (#4b).

text.title: The return bond — knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with
text.italic: The whole returns-to the two logics with the exact difference: polar distinction is necessary; its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation — separation's return must preserve the achievement.

text.body: Knowing-as-cutting is answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of shared genesis; even denial takes place through the field it denies. (-1)+(+1)=0 cancels; the subtractions appropriate; (0/1)/(1/0) retains the directions together. Name walks with Power; the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign.
Occurrences: the marriage bond and shared genesis (#0, #5→0); the Name and Power series (#5→0); the paper scene's return into another act (#4, #5→0).
